expert_translation: He looks after his money the way storks pursue locusts.
openai_translation: One does not hide a wound like a sore.
openai_reasoning: The proverb suggests that one cannot conceal their pain or suffering, similar to how a wound cannot be hidden if it is severe. It emphasizes the idea that true feelings or struggles are often visible and cannot be easily masked, akin to a sore that draws attention. This interpretation captures the essence of the original Kikuyu saying.
cohere_translation: A patient person will always succeed.
cohere_reasoning: The Kikuyu proverb 'Aikaragia mbia ta njuu ngigi' literally translates to 'Patience bears fruits on top of the tree'. This proverb emphasizes the reward of patience, suggesting that those who are patient will eventually reap benefits that are as high and valuable as fruits on top of a tree. Therefore, the essence of the proverb is captured in the English translation 'A patient person will always succeed'.
